issues.description: Timeout-based bookend state machine races with end-of-stream close and in-flight frames
issues.detail: _push_text_frame schedules a 1.0s timer to emit LLMFullResponseEndFrame, while process_frame also closes at end-of-stream. The timer can fire mid-await, producing double-End, End-before-Text, or interleaved bookends on the next invocation. The stream has a real end signal: emit Start once before the loop, End once after, drop the timer.

issues.description: Boto client is recreated per invocation inside process_frame
issues.detail: Every LLMContextFrame opens a fresh bedrock-agentcore client via aioboto3, incurring TLS setup, credential resolution, and teardown on the hot path of a voice pipeline. Create the client once at setup, reuse across invocations, and close in cleanup.

issues.description: default_response_to_output_transformer can raise JSONDecodeError and abort the stream
issues.detail: json.loads on response_line has no try/except. A malformed SSE line, error payload, or keepalive crashes the entire invocation with an unhandled exception, leaving _output_response_open=True and a dangling close task. Either catch and return None, or document the precondition and enforce it at the call site.

issues.description: agentArn parameter violates PEP 8 and the surrounding snake_case API
issues.detail: Every other __init__ arg uses snake_case (aws_access_key, aws_region). agentArn mirrors the boto field name at the public boundary. Rename to agent_arn and translate to agentRuntimeArn at the call site where the foreign convention lives.

issues.description: Default context transformer silently joins multimodal parts with missing text keys
issues.detail: ' '.join([part.get('text', '') for part in content]) emits empty strings for image/tool parts, producing double spaces and silently dropping non-text content. Filter then join, or document explicitly that only text parts are supported and refuse the rest.

issues.description: SSE parsing is hand-rolled and brittle inside process_frame
issues.detail: split('\n'), startswith('data: '), and slice [6:] mix transport parsing with business logic and assume exactly one space after 'data:', which SSE does not guarantee. Extract a small generator (bytes-in, line-out) using removeprefix, so process_frame is transform-and-push rather than transport plumbing.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on a NEEDS-WORK verdict centered on the response-framing state machine: a 1.0s sleep-based timer for LLMFullResponseEndFrame races with explicit end-of-stream close and in-flight text frames, and should be replaced by deterministic Start/End bookends around the loop. Two other systemic issues: the boto client is rebuilt per invocation on a voice hot path, and json.loads on streamed lines is unguarded and can wedge the processor. Public API discipline is also broken (agentArn vs snake_case). Smaller wins around SSE parsing and the default context transformer round out the list.
